ge/nesis.head: γένεσις
ge/nesis.html: γένεσις ἡ [γεν-, γίγνομαι.] Source, origin: Ὠκεανόν, θεῶν γένεσιν Il. 14.201 = 302. Cf. Il. 14.246.

gerou/sios.head: γερούσιος
gerou/sios.html: γερούσιος [γέρων.] Of an oath, taken by the elders or councillors (as representing the people) Il. 22.119. Of wine, such as is served at assemblies of councillors Il. 4.259: Od. 13.8.

glukero/s.head: γλυκερός
glukero/s.html: γλυκερός -ή, -όν [cf. γλυκύς.] 1 Sweet or pleasant to the taste: σίτου Il. 11.89: συκέαι Od. 7.116 = Od. 11.590 (the tree for the fruit). Cf. Od. 4.88, Od. 14.194, Od. 20.69, Od. 24.68. Of water, sweet, fit for drinking Od. 12.306. 2 Generally, sweet, pleasant, giving delight or joy: ὕπνος Il. 10.4, μολπῆς Il. 13.637. Cf. Il. 24.3, 636: Od. 4.295, Od. 5.472, Od. 16.23 = Od. 17.41, Od. 19.511, Od. 22.323, Od. 23.145, 255. In comp.: ἧς γαίης γλυκερώτερον ἄλλο Od. 9.28.

ghra/skw.head: γηράσκω
ghra/skw.html: γηράσκω [γῆρας.] From γηράω 3 sing. impf. ἐγήρα Il. 7.148, Il. 17.197. γήρα Od. 14.67. Also non-thematic pres. pple. γηράς Il. 17.197. (κατα-.) To grow old: ἤδη γηράσκοντα Il. 2.663. Cf. Il. 7.148, Il. 17.197 (twice), 325, Il. 24.541: Od. 4.210, Od. 14.67, Od. 15.409. Of fruit, to mellow Od. 7.120.

gono/essa.head: Γονόεσσα
gono/essa.html: Γονόεσσα (αἰπεινή). A town in Agamemnon's realm Il. 2.573.

ghqe/w.head: γηθέω
ghqe/w.html: γηθέω 3 sing. pf. (in pres. sense) γέγηθε Il. 8.559: Od. 6.106. 3 sing. plupf. (in impf. sense) γεγήθει Il. 11.683, Il. 13.494. 1 To rejoice, be glad Il. 1.255, Il. 6.212, Il. 7.189, Il. 8.559, Il. 11.683, Il. 13.416, 494, Il. 16.530, Il. 17.567, Il. 24.424: Od. 6.106, Od. 7.269, 329 = Od. 8.199 = Od. 13.250 = Od. 18.281, Od. 8.385, Od. 13.353 = Od. 21.414, Od. 20.104, Od. 24.382. With complementary pple.: οὐδὲ τὼ ἰδὼν γήθησεν Il. 1.330. Cf. Il. 4.255, 283, 311, Il. 7.214, Il. 8.278, Il. 10.190, Il. 13.344, Il. 14.140, Il. 24.321: Od. 5.486 = Od. 24.504, Od. 12.88, Od. 13.226, Od. 15.165, Od. 22.207. With acc. of what is rejoiced at: νῶϊ προφανέντε Il. 8.378, τάδε Il. 9.77. 2 To take pleasure or delight in doing something. With pple.: Ἀργείων ἐρέων γενεήν Il. 7.127.

gaih/oxos.head: γαιήοχος
gaih/oxos.html: γαιήοχος [γαιη-, γαῖα + ὀχ-, ἔχω.] Epithet or a name of Poseidon. Prob., earth-embracing, the earth-embracer (connecting Poseidon with the earth-encircling river Ocean) Il. 13.83, 125, Il. 15.174, 201, Il. 20.34: Od. 1.68, Od. 3.55, Od. 8.322, 350, Od. 9.528. Joined with ἐννοσίγαιος Il. 9.183, Il. 13.43, 59, 677, Il. 14.355, Il. 15.222, Il. 23.584: Od. 11.241.

ge/lws.head: γέλως
ge/lws.html: γέλως ὁ [γελάω.] Dat. γέλῳ Od. 18.100. Acc. γέλω Od. 18.350, Od. 20.8, 346. Laughter Il. 1.599: = Od. 8.326, Od. 8.343, 344, Od. 18.100, 350, Od. 20.8, 346.

glafuro/s.head: γλαφυρός
glafuro/s.html: γλαφυρός -ή, -όν [γλάφω = γλύφω. See γλυφίς, and cf. διαγλάφω.] Hollow, hollowed (for the most part as a conventional epithet). Of caves Il. 18.402, Il. 24.83: Od. 1.15 = Od. 9.30, Od. 1.73, Od. 2.20, Od. 4.403, Od. 5.68, 155, 194, 226, Od. 9.114, 476, Od. 12.210, Od. 23.335. Of rocks, having a cavity or cavities Il. 2.88: Od. 14.533. Of the lyre Od. 8.257, Od. 17.262, Od. 22.340, Od. 23.144. Of a harbour (referring to the curved outline) Od. 12.305. Elsewhere epithet of ships Il. 2.454, 516, Il. 3.119, Il. 5.327, Il. 8.180, etc.: Od. 3.287, Od. 4.356, 513, Od. 9.99, Od. 10.23, etc.

glau=kos.head: Γλαῦκος-1
glau=kos.html:
Γλαῦκος-1 Son of Sisyphus, father of Bellerophon and grandfather of Hippolochus-1 Il. 6.154, 155.
Γλαῦκος-2 (ἀμύμων, κρατερός , ποιμήν λαῶν, φαίδιμος ). Son of Hippolochus-1. Comrade of Sarpedon and a leader of the Lycians Il. 2.876; fights Diomedes Il. 6.119, they exchange arms 234; Il. 7.13 , Il. 12.102, 309, 310, 329; wounded by Teucrus Il. 12.387; 392; Il. 14.426 ; the wounded Sarpedon appeals to him Il. 16.492, 508, he cries to Apollo 514, and is cured 527, 530; slays Bathyclees Il. 16.593, 597; reproves Hector Il. 17.140, 170; Il. 17.216 .

ge/neion.head: γένειον
ge/neion.html: γένειον -ου, τό [γένυς.] The chin Il. 8.371, Il. 10.454, Il. 22.74, Il. 24.516: Od. 11.583, Od. 16.176, Od. 19.473.

ge.head: γε
ge.html: γε enclitic. Calling attention to a word or fact or distinguishing it from others: εἴ κε θάνατόν γε φύγοιμεν Il. 1.60, ἐπεί μʼ ἀφέλεσθέ γε δόντες 299 ( δόντες being here the word emphasized). Cf. Il. 1.81, 216, 286, 352, 393, 506, etc.: κεῖνός γε ἐοικότι κεῖται ὀλέθρῳ Od. 1.46, ὅτις τοιαῦτά γε ῥέζοι 47. Cf. Od. 1.10, 203, 222, 223, 229, 339, etc.–γʼ οὖν in any case: εἴ γʼ οὖν ἕτερός γε φύγῃσιν (if indeed one does escape) Il. 5.258, μὴ ἐμέ γʼ οὖν οὗν οὗτός γε λάβοι χόλος (far be it from me) Il. 16.30.

ge/ras.head: γέρας
ge/ras.html: γέρας τό. Acc. pl. with hyphaeresis γέρᾶ (for γέραα) Il. 2.237, Il. 9.334: Od. 4.66. 1 A meed of honour, a special prize apart from the general division of spoils (represented as assigned sometimes to the king or a chief by the general consent (as in Il. 1.118, 123, 135, 276, Il. 16.56, Il. 18.444: Od. 7.10), sometimes to chiefs by the king (as in Il. 9.334, 367). (But cf. Il. 9.130, 272, Il. 11.696, where the king is represented as choosing his prize)) Il. 1.118, 120, 123, 133, 135, 138, 161, 163, 167, 185, 276, 356 = 507 = Il. 2.240, Il. 2.237, Il. 9.111, 334, 344, 367, Il. 16.54, 56, Il. 18.444, Il. 19.89: Od. 7.10, Od. 11.534. 2 Something given by way of showing honour to a person: νῶτα βοός, τά οἱ γέρα πάρθεσαν Od. 4.66. 3 An honour paid: τὸ γὰρ λάχομεν γ. ἡμεῖς Il. 4.49 = Il. 24.70. Cf. Il. 16.457 = 675, Il. 23.9: Od. 4.197, Od. 24.190, 296. 4 A privilege: γερόντων Il. 4.323, Il. 9.422. 5 The dignity or honours of a king: οὔ τοι Πρίαμος γ. ἐν χερὶ θήσει Il. 20.182. Cf. Od. 11.175, 184, Od. 15.522. App., any hereditary honour or privilege bestowed on a king or a chief by the people: γ. ὅ τι δῆμος ἔδωκεν Od. 7.150. 6 A gratuity: λοετροχόῳ Od. 20.297.

gh=.head: γῆ
gh=.html: γῆ γῆς, ἡ [cf. γαῖα.] 1 The earth = γαῖα 1: ὄφρʼ ἂν ἵκηται γῆν Il. 15.24, φυσίζοος Il. 21.63. Personified Il. 3.104, Il. 19.259. 2 The earth as distinguished from the sea, the land = γαῖα 2..b: ἢ ἁλὸς ἢ ἐπὶ γῆς Od. 12.27. Cf. Od. 21.233. 3 A particular land or country = γαῖα 4: τίς γῆ; Od. 13.233. One's native land: ἁμῆς γῆς Od. 11.167, 482. 4 The surface of the earth, the ground = γαῖα 5: νέρθεν γῆς Od. 11.302, ἦ πρὸς γῆν ἐλάσειε κάρη Od. 17.237.

gennai=os.head: γενναῖος
gennai=os.html: γενναῖος [γεν-, γίγνομαι.] Suited to (noble) birth, seemly, honourable Il. 5.253.

gumno/s.head: γυμνός
gumno/s.html: γυμνός 1 Without clothes, naked: σὲ εὐλαὶ ἔδονται γυμνόν Il. 22.510. Cf. Od. 6.136. 2 Without armour, unarmed: κτενέει με γυμνὸν ἐόντα Il. 22.124. Cf. Il. 16.815, Il. 17.122 = 693, 711, Il. 18.21, Il. 21.50. 3 Of a bow, out of its case Od. 11.607. Of an arrow, out of the quiver Od. 21.417.

gorguqi/wn.head: Γοργυθίων
gorguqi/wn.html: Γοργυθίων (ἀμύμων, ἐΰς). Son of Priam by Castianeira. Killed by Teucrus Il. 8.302.

go/rgeios.head: Γόργειος
go/rgeios.html: Γόργειος Adj. fr. Γοργώ Il. 5.741 : Od. 11.634.

ge/fura.head: γέφυρα
ge/fura.html: γέφυρα ἡ. 1 A dike or embankment to confine a river: ποταμὸς ἐκέδασσε γεφύρας Il. 5.88. Cf. Il. 5.89. 2 π(τ)ολέμοιο γέφυραι, app., ranks of men thought of as stemming the tide of warIl. 4.371, Il. 8.378, Il. 11.160, Il. 20.427. In Il. 8.553 (ἐπὶ πτολέμοιο γεφύρας ἥατο) app., preserving (more or less) the stations in which they had fought.

gumno/w.head: γυμνόω
gumno/w.html: γυμνόω [γυμνός.] (ἀπο-) To make naked. In pass. 1 To become naked, strip oneself: αἰδέομαι γυμνοῦσθαι Od. 6.222. Cf. Od. 10.341. To strip oneself of. With genit.: γυμνώθη ῥακέων Od. 22.1. 2 To be left unprotected by armour or shield: οὖτα γυμνωθέντα Il. 16.312 = 400. Cf. Il. 12.389, 428. Of a wall, to be left bare of defence Il. 12.399.

glauko/s.head: γλαυκός
glauko/s.html: γλαυκός -ή. Bright, shining, gleaming (prob. without any notion of colour). Of the sea Il. 16.34.

glaukia/w.head: †γλαυκιάω
glaukia/w.html: †γλαυκιάω [γλαυκός.] Pres. pple. γλαυκιόων. To have the eyes bright or glaring. Of a lion Il. 20.172.

goa/w.head: †γοάω
goa/w.html: †γοάω [γόος.] 1 pl. opt. γοάοιμεν Il. 24.664. γοάοιεν Od. 24.190. Pple. γοόων, -ωντος Od. 10.209, Od. 12.234, Od. 19.119. Contr. pl. γοῶντες Il. 18.315, 355: Od. 9.467. Fem. γοόωσα, -ης Il. 5.413, Il. 6.373, Il. 16.857, Il. 22.363, 476, Il. 23.106: Od. 4.721, 800, Od. 19.210, 264, 513. Non-thematic infin. γοήμεναι Il. 14.502. 3 pl. impf. γόων Od. 10.567. 3 sing. pa. iterative γοάασκε Od. 8.92. 3 sing. fut. in mid. form γοήσεται Il. 21.124, Il. 22.353. 3 pl. aor. γόον (perh. formed fr. γόος) Il. 6.500. 1 To weep, wail, show signs of grief: μὴ γοόωσα οἰκῆας ἐγείρῃ Il. 5.413. Cf. Il. 6.373, Il. 18.315, 355, Il. 22.476, Il. 23.106: ἑζόμενοι γόων Od. 10.567. Cf. Od. 4.721, 800, Od. 8.92, Od. 9.467, Od. 10.209, Od. 12.234, Od. 19.119, 210, 513. 2 To weep for, bewail, lament, mourn for the loss of: Ἕκτορα Il. 6.500, ὃν πότμον Il. 16.857 = Il. 22.363: πόσιν Od. 19.264. 3 To pay mourning rites to: αὐτόν Il. 24.664. Cf. Il. 14.502, Il. 21.124, Il. 22.353: Od. 24.190.

glau/kh.head: Γλαύκη
glau/kh.html: Γλαύκη A Nereid Il. 18.39 .

gamyw=nuc.head: γαμψῶνυξ
gamyw=nuc.html: γαμψῶνυξ -υχος [γαμψ- = καμψ-, κάμπτω + ὄνυξ.] With hooked talons: αἰγυπιοί Il. 16.428: = Od. 22.302, Od. 16.217.

gluku/s.head: γλυκύς
gluku/s.html: γλυκύς -ύ. Comp. γλυκίων, γλύκιον Il. 1.249, Il. 2.453, Il. 11.13, Il. 18.109: Od. 9.34. 1 Sweet or pleasant to the taste: νέκταρ Il. 1.598. 2 Generally, sweet, pleasant: ὕπνος Il. 1.610, ἵμερον Il. 3.139. Cf. Il. 2.71, Il. 3.446, Il. 14.328, Il. 23.232: αἰών Od. 5.152. Cf. Od. 2.395, Od. 7.289, Od. 8.445, Od. 9.333, Od. 10.31 = Od. 13.282, Od. 10.548, Od. 12.338, Od. 15.7, Od. 18.188, 199, Od. 19.49, Od. 22.500, Od. 23.342. In comp. Il. 1.249, Il. 2.453 = Il. 11.13, Il. 18.109: Od. 9.34.

gh=rus.head: γῆρυς
gh=rus.html: γῆρυς ἡ. Voice Il. 4.437.

gra/fw.head: †γράφω
gra/fw.html: †γράφω 3 sing. aor. γράψε Il. 17.599. Pple. γράψας Il. 6.169. (ἐπι-.) 1 To scratch, cut into, incise: δ'στέον Il. 17.599. 2 To form by scratching or incision: θυμοφθόρα Il. 6.169.

gorgw/.head: Γοργώ
gorgw/.html: Γοργώ (βλοσυρῶπις). A frightful phantom Il. 8.349, Il. 11.36.

glw=ssa.head: γλῶσσα
glw=ssa.html: γλῶσσα -ης, ἡ. 1 The tongue Il. 1.249, Il. 2.489, Il. 5.74, 292, Il. 16.161, Il. 17.618, Il. 20.248. Of the tongues of sacrificial victims Od. 3.332, 341. 2 A tongue or language Il. 2.804: Od. 19.175. Language, speech: γ. ἐμέμικτο Il. 4.438.

gurtw/nh.head: Γυρτώνη
gurtw/nh.html: Γυρτώνη A town of Thessaly. Its men led by Polypoetes and Leonteus Il. 2.738.

gunaimanh/s.head: γυναιμανής
gunaimanh/s.html: γυναιμανής [γυναι-, γυνή + μαν-, μαίνομαι.] Mad for women Il. 3.39 = Il. 13.769.

grh/nikos.head: Γρήνικος
grh/nikos.html: Γρήνικος A river of the Troad west of the Aesepus-1 Il. 12.21.

gi/gnomai.head: γίγνομαι
gi/gnomai.html: γίγνομαι [redup. fr. γ(ε)ν-.] A 3 sing. pa. iterative γενέσκετο Od. 11.208. Aor. γενόμην Il. 18.102, Il. 19.219, Il. 21.440: Od. 8.311, Od. 14.141. 2 sing. γένευ Il. 5.897. 3 sing. γένετο Il. 1.49, Il. 6.153, Il. 13.417, Il. 23.526, etc.: Od. 2.26, Od. 4.11, Od. 24.292, etc. 3 dual γενέσθην Il. 5.548: Od. 11.255, 307, 312. 1 pl. γενόμεσθα Il. 21.89. With metrical lengthening of the first syllable γεινόμεθα Il. 22.477 (v.l. γιγνόμεθα). 2 pl. ἐγένεσθε Il. 2.323. 3 pl. (ἐ)γένοντο Il. 3.84, Il. 4.382, Il. 5.63, Il. 7.313, etc.: Od. 7.144, Od. 8.234, Od. 18.345, Od. 21.24, etc. Subj. γένωμαι Il. 8.180, Il. 16.39, Il. 22.358: Od. 5.473, Od. 11.73, Od. 22.167. 2 sing. -ηαι Il. 8.282, Il. 11.797: Od. 10.486. 3 sing. -ηται Il. 1.341, Il. 6.489, Il. 19.201, etc.: Od. 2.374, Od. 8.553, Od. 17.23, etc. 1 pl. -ώμεθα Il. 10.193, Il. 13.236, Il. 17.636. 2 pl. -ησθε Il. 5.488. 3 pl. -ωνται Il. 2.397, Il. 20.308. Opt. γενοίμην Il. 17.38: Od. 14.338, Od. 16.103. 2 sing. -οιο Od. 9.456, Od. 14.440, Od. 15.341, Od. 18.79. 3 sing. -οιτο Il. 4.17, Il. 8.26, Il. 13.233, etc.: Od. 3.129, Od. 8.414, Od. 18.161, etc. 1 pl. -οίμεθα Il. 13.485. 2 pl. -οισθε Il. 7.99. 3 pl. -οίατο Il. 2.340: Od. 1.266, Od. 4.346, Od. 17.137. 3 sing. imp. γενέσθω Il. 8.181: Od. 5.224, Od. 17.285, Od. 22.491. Pple. (with metrical lengthening of the first syllable) γεινόμενος, -ου (vv. ll. γιγνόμενος, -ου) Il. 10.71, Il. 20.128, Il. 23.79, Il. 24.210: Od. 4.208, Od. 7.198. Infin. γενέσθαι Il. 3.323, Il. 7.199, Il. 17.151, etc.: Od. 1.220, Od. 4.173, Od. 15.480, etc. 3 sing. pf. γέγονε Il. 19.122. 3 pl. γεγάασι Il. 4.325: Od. 5.35, Od. 6.62, Od. 9.118, Od. 10.5, Od. 13.160, Od. 19.279, Od. 24.84. 3 sing. plupf. γεγόνει Il. 13.355. Acc. sing. masc. pple. γεγαῶτα Il. 9.456: Od. 4.112, 144, Od. 19.400. Acc. pl. γεγαῶτας Il. 2.866. (For these pf. forms cf. μάω, μέμονα under μάω.) B 2 sing. aor. ἐγείναο Il. 5.880. 3 sing. (ἐ)γείνατο Il. 1.280, Il. 4.476, Il. 5.800, Il. 13.777, Il. 15.526, Il. 21.85, etc.: Od. 1.223, Od. 4.13, Od. 6.25, Od. 7.57, 61, Od. 11.268, 299, Od. 15.242, Od. 21.172. 2 sing. subj. γείνεαι Od. 20.202. Infin. γείνασθαι Il. 21.160: Od. 8.312. (ἐγ-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, παρα-, περι-, προ-.) I In pres. and impf. and forms (A), to come into being. 1 To be born, take one's being: τράφεν ἠδʼ ἐγένοντο Il. 1.251, τῶν ἓξ ἐγένοντο Il. 5.270, πρότερος γενόμην (am the elder) Il. 19.219, Il. 21.440. Cf. Il. 5.548, 897, Il. 6.206, 489, Il. 10.71, etc.: τοῦ μʼ ἔκ φασι γενέσθαι Od. 1.220, γαμέοντί τε γεινομένῳ τε Od. 4.208. Cf. Od. 3.28, Od. 4.723, Od. 7.198, Od. 8.311, Od. 10.350, etc. 2 In pf., to be in the condition of having been born; hence simply, to exist, live, be: οἳ ὁπλότεροι γεγάασιν Il. 4.325: ἐν αἶγες γεγάασιν Od. 9.118, οἳ νῦν γεγάασιν Od. 24.84. Cf. Od. 5.35 = Od. 19.279, Od. 6.62, Od. 10.5, Od. 13.160. In more strict pf. sense: ἤδη ἀνὴρ γέγονʼ ἐσθλός (has been born, is born) Il. 19.122. Sim. in plupf.: Ζεὺς πρότερος γεγόνει (had been born earlier, was the elder) Il. 13.355. In pple., born Il. 9.456: Od. 4.112, 144, Od. 19.400. So ὑπὸ τμώλῳ γεγαῶτας (born (and dwelling) there) Il. 2.866. 3 To come into view or notice, be seen, heard, etc.: κλαγγή Il. 1.49, ὀδμή Il. 14.415, σέλας Il. 19.374. Cf. Il. 4.456, Il. 10.375, Il. 11.50, Il. 15.607, Il. 22.150, etc.: Od. 12.87, 396, Od. 22.77, 133, Od. 23.137. 4 Of natural phenomena, natural products, etc., to come into being, rise, grow, be: φύλλα καὶ ἄνθεα Il. 2.468. Cf. Il. 2.397: ἐκ νυκτῶν ἄνεμοι γίγνονται Od. 12.287, ἐν οἶνος γίγνεται Od. 13.245, χιὼν γένετο (fell) Od. 14.476. Cf. Od. 9.51, Od. 12.326, Od. 17.23, Od. 22.491. 5 To come to or upon, fall to, befall, be the lot of, affect (a person). With dat.: Πηλεΐωνι ἄχος Il. 1.188, αἰδώς οἱ Il. 24.45. Cf. Il. 3.323, Il. 4.245, 289, Il. 9.125, Il. 14.98, Il. 19.274, etc.: παντα οἱ γένοιτο Od. 17.355, μὴ νῶϊν ἔρις γένηται Od. 18.13. Cf. Od. 8.414, Od. 11.208, Od. 18.122 = Od. 20.199, Od. 18.366, Od. 19.569, Od. 21.412. For ἐμὲ χρεὼ γίγνεται Od. 4.634 see χρειώ 1.a. Without case: ποινὴ οὔ τις ἐγίγνετο Il. 13.659. Cf. Il. 1.341, Il. 9.380, Il. 21.529: Od. 22.306. 6 To be manifested or shown, to be, come into play, take effect: οὔ τις φειδὼ γίγνεται (there is no . . .) Il. 7.410, μνημοσύνη τις γενέσθω (let there be . . .) Il. 8.181. Cf. Il. 15.359, Il. 23.505: εἰ γὰρ ἐπʼ ἀρῇσιν τέλος γένοιτο Od. 17.496. Cf. Od. 10.202 = 568. 7 To happen, occur, come round, come to pass, take place: ἠώς Il. 1.493, τάδε ἔργα Il. 6.348, ἀγορή Il. 7.345. Cf. Il. 3.110, 176, Il. 8.130, Il. 17.686, Il. 24.436, etc.: νόστον γενέσθαι Od. 4.173. Cf. Od. 1.379, Od. 2.26, 374, Od. 3.129, 228, Od. 4.747, Od. 5.299, Od. 11.537, Od. 12.191, Od. 24.455, 461, etc. 8 To become, come to be, prove to be so and so: ὁμηγερέες Il. 1.57, ἄνεῳ Il. 2.323, ἐν πυρὶ βουλαὶ γενοίατο (be cast) 340, κλισίῃσιν ἐν Ἀτρεΐδαο γένοντο (reached the . . .) Il. 7.313. Cf. Il. 2.453, Il. 3.71, Il. 4.17, 466, Il. 8.180, Il. 20.497, Il. 22.421, etc.: λέων γένετο Od. 4.456, ὄφρʼ ἔτι δύης ἐπὶ πῆμα γενοίμην (be brought into . . .) Od. 14.338, φόνος οἱ γένοντο Od. 21.24. Cf. Od. 1.266, Od. 3.271, Od. 7.154, 316, Od. 15.446, Od. 16.175, etc. 9 Passes from this last sense into that, practically, of the copula, to be so and so: οὔ πώ τις ὁμοῖος γένετʼ ἀνήρ (was) Il. 2.553, ὃν κάρτιστον Ἀχαιῶν φημὶ γενέσθαι (that he is) Il. 6.98, ζαχρηεῖς γίγνοντο (were wont to be) Il. 13.684, ἀρίγνωτος Διὸς γίγνεται ἀλκή Il. 15.490. Cf. Il. 4.375, Il. 6.153, 210, Il. 13.569, Il. 16.746, Il. 20.220, etc.: οὐ νηὸς ἐπήβολος γίγνομαι Od. 2.320, τηλύγετος Od. 4.11 (after ἐκ δούλης in 12 supply γεγαώς). Cf. Od. 4.201, 362, Od. 5.224, Od. 8.586, Od. 9.35, Od. 17.223, Od. 19.344, Od. 22.130, etc. II In forms (B), to give (a person) being. 1 Of the father, to beget: παῖδα γείνατο τυδεύς Il. 5.800. Cf. Il. 4.400, Il. 5.880, Il. 15.526, Il. 21.160: υἷε κραταιώ Od. 15.242. Cf. Od. 7.61, Od. 20.202. 2 Of the mother, to bear: θεά σε γείνατο μήτηρ Il. 1.280. Cf. Il. 3.238, Il. 4.476, Il. 5.896, Il. 6.24, 26, Il. 24.608, etc.: ἥ ῥʼ Ἡρακλῆα γείνατο Od. 11.268. Cf. Od. 1.223, Od. 4.13, Od. 6.25, Od. 11.299, Od. 21.172. 3 Of both parents Il. 7.10, Il. 21.142: Od. 7.57, Od. 8.312.

gnwto/s.head: γνωτός
gnwto/s.html: γνωτός -ή, -όν [γνω-, γιγνώσκω.] 1 Easy to be known, evident: γνωτόν [ἐστιν] ὡς . . . Il. 7.401 Cf. Od. 24.182. 2 As sb. a A kinsman or kinswoman: γνωτοὺς λιποῦσα Il. 3.174, γνωτοί τε γνωταί τε Il. 15.350. Cf. Il. 13.697 = Il. 15.336. b More specifically, a brother (and the word may bear this sense in the passages under a) Il. 14.485, Il. 17.35, Il. 22.234.

gurtia/dhs.head: Γυρτιάδης
gurtia/dhs.html: Γυρτιάδης Patronymic of Hyrtius Il. 14.512.

gefuro/w.head: γεφυρόω
gefuro/w.html: γεφυρόω [γέφυρα.] 1 To dam (a river) Il. 21.245. 2 To make (a way) by forming an embankment: γεφύρωσε κέλευθον Il. 15.357.

gnaqmo/s.head: γναθμός
gnaqmo/s.html: γναθμός -οῦ, ὁ. The lower jaw Il. 13.671 = Il. 16.606, Il. 16.405, Il. 17.617. In pl., the jaws Od. 16.175, Od. 18.29, Od. 20.347.

gignw/skw.head: γιγνώσκω
gignw/skw.html: γιγνώσκω [redup. fr. γνω-.] 2 sing. fut. in mid. form γνώσεαι Il. 2.367, Il. 10.88: Od. 16.310. γνώσῃ Il. 2.365. 3 sing. -εται Il. 8.17, Il. 18.270. 1 pl. -όμεθα Od. 23.109. 2 pl. -εσθε Il. 23.497, Il. 24.242. Aor. ἔγνων Il. 11.526, Il. 13.72: Od. 15.532, Od. 19.475. 2 sing. ἔγνως Il. 20.20, Il. 22.10: Od. 13.299, Od. 17.273. 3 sing. ἔγνω Il. 1.199, Il. 13.66, Il. 16.530, Il. 17.32, etc.: Od. 1.3, Od. 5.444, Od. 7.234, Od. 11.91, etc. γνῶ Il. 4.357, Il. 7.189, Il. 10.358, Il. 11.439, Il. 16.119, 658: Od. 19.468. 3 dual γνώτην Od. 21.36. 3 pl. ἔγνωσαν Od. 10.397. Subj. γνώω Od. 14.118, Od. 17.549. 2 sing. γνώῃς Il. 23.487. γνῷς Od. 22.373. 3 sing. γνώῃ Il. 24.688: Od. 17.556. γνῷ Il. 1.411, Il. 16.273. 2 dual γνῶτον Od. 21.218. 1 pl. γνώομεν Od. 16.304. γνῶμεν Il. 22.382. 3 pl. γνώωσι Il. 1.302, Il. 23.610, 661, Il. 24.688. γνῶσι Il. 6.231. Opt. γνοίην Il. 3.235. 2 sing. γνοίης Il. 3.53, Il. 5.85, Il. 14.58: Od. 15.537, Od. 17.164, Od. 19.310, Od. 20.237, Od. 21.202. 3 sing. γνοίη Il. 17.630: Od. 13.192, Od. 16.458, Od. 17.363. 3 pl. γνοῖεν Il. 18.125. Imp. pl. γνῶτε Il. 19.84. Infin. γνώμεναι Il. 2.349, Il. 21.266, 609: Od. 1.411. γνῶναι Od. 2.159, Od. 13.312, Od. 24.159. (ἀνα-, δια-, ἐπι-.) 1 a To perceive, mark, remark, note, find, see, know: ἣν ἄτην Il. 1.411 = Il. 16.273, Διὸς τάλαντα Il. 16.658. Cf. Il. 12.272, Il. 16.119, 362, Il. 19.84. b With acc. and complementary pple.: γιγνώσκω Ἄρηα κοιρανέοντα Il. 5.824. Cf. Il. 14.154, Il. 17.84: Od. 15.532, Od. 17.549, 556. With pple. alone: ὅτε γίγνωσκε θεοῦ γόνον ἐόντα Il. 6.191: γνῶναι τὸν ἐόντα (that it was he) Od. 24.159. With a sim. pple. in genit.: ὡς γνῶ χωομένοιο Il. 4.357. With adj.: γνῶ. ἄνδρας δηΐους (that they were . . .) Il. 10.358. c With acc. and dependent clause: γιγνώσκω σε, ὅττι . . . Il. 24.563. Cf. Il. 5.85. With clause only: γνώμεναι εἰ . . . Il. 2.349. Cf. Il. 2.365, Il. 3.53, Il. 6.231, Il. 8.17, Il. 14.58, Il. 18.125, Il. 21.609, etc.: γνοίης χʼ οἵη ἐμὴ δύναμίς [ἐστιν] Od. 20.237. Cf. Od. 3.166, Od. 8.299, Od. 17.269, 363, Od. 22.373, etc. d Absol.: ἵνα γνώωσι καὶ οἵδε Il. 1.302. Cf. Il. 1.333 = Il. 8.446, Il. 13.66, Il. 22.296, Il. 23.487, Il. 24.242: γιγνώσκω, φρονέω Od. 16.136 = Od. 17.193 = 281, Od. 17.273, Od. 19.160. 2 To gain knowledge of, get to know, learn: Τρώων νόον Il. 22.382. Cf. Od. 1.3, Od. 16.304. To get to know, make the acquaintance of (a person) Od. 1.411. So with genit.: ἀλλήλων Od. 21.36. To become aware of the presence of, discover (a person) Il. 24.688 (twice), 691. To experience, find: φιλότητα Od. 15.537 = Od. 17.164 = Od. 19.310. 3 a To have knowledge, know: ὅσσον ἔγωγε γιγνώσκω Il. 13.223. With dependent clause: γιγνώσκων ὅ τʼ ἄναλκις ἔην θεός Il. 5.331. Cf. Il. 5.433: Od. 21.209. b In aor., to know: ἔγνως ἐμὴν βουλήν (knowest) Il. 20.20. To know (a person): αἴ κέ ποθι γνώω τοιοῦτον ἐόντα (in case I may find that I know him, seeing he was such a one, i.e. such as to be likely to be known) Od. 14.118. 4 To distinguish, discern: ἠμὲν θεὸν ἠδὲ καὶ ἄνδρα Il. 5.128. Cf. Il. 13.72. With acc. and dependent clause: ἵππους οἳ δεύτεροι οἵ τε πάροιθεν Il. 23.497. 5 To know (a person or thing) for what he or it is, know the nature of, know: εὖ σε γιγνώσκων Il. 22.356. Cf. Il. 17.32 = Il. 20.198, Il. 18.270: ἔγνω [ποταμόν] (i.e. recognized him for a god) Od. 5.444, καλάμην γιγνώσκειν (i.e. can judge from that what I was) Od. 14.215. Cf. Od. 2.159, Od. 16.310. Sim.: θεὸν ἔγνω (knew that it was a god) Od. 1.420. Absol., to recognize one's claim, hold it good Il. 23.661. 6 To know again, recognize, know: Ἀθηναίην Il. 1.199. Cf. Il. 3.235, Il. 5.182, 815, Il. 7.189, Il. 10.88, Il. 11.111, 526, 651, Il. 14.475, Il. 15.241, Il. 16.639, Il. 17.334, Il. 24.698: φᾶρος Od. 7.234. Cf. Od. 10.397, Od. 11.91, 153, 390, 471, 615, Od. 13.188, 192, 299, 312, Od. 16.458, Od. 19.392, 468, 475, Od. 21.218, Od. 22.501, Od. 24.102. Absol. Il. 7.185, Il. 23.453: Od. 20.94. To find means of recognizing. With genit.: ἀλλήλων Od. 23.109.

ge/rwn.head: γέρων
ge/rwn.html: γέρων -οντος, ὁ [cf. γῆρας.] Voc. γέρον Il. 1.26, 286, Il. 2.370, 796, etc.: Od. 2.40, 178, 192, Od. 3.226, etc. Dat. pl. γέρουσι Il. 4.344, Il. 6.113, Il. 9.70. 1 a An old man: ἔδεισεν ὁ γ. Il. 1.33, ἠμὲν νέοι ἠδὲ γέροντες Il. 2.789. Cf. Il. 1.380, 538, Il. 3.109, 181, Il. 8.518, etc.: πείθεσθαι γέροντι Od. 2.227 (app. Laertes, as Mentor, described (225) as Ὀδυσῆος ἑταῖρος, was hardly a γ.). Cf. Od. 2.39, Od. 3.390, Od. 4.349, Od. 8.570, Od. 11.38, etc. b In voc. in a tone of respect Il. 1.286, Il. 2.370, Il. 4.313, Il. 8.102, Il. 9.115, etc.: Od. 2.40, Od. 3.226, 331, 357, Od. 24.244. Without such a tone Il. 1.26: Od. 2.178, 192, Od. 4.465, 485, Od. 14.37, 45, 122, 166, 386, 508, Od. 18.10, Od. 24.394, 407. 2 In apposition: παρὰ πατρὶ γέροντι Il. 1.358. Cf. Il. 2.793, Il. 5.149, Il. 7.125, etc.: Od. 1.188, Od. 2.157, Od. 3.436, etc. 3 As a proper adj., old, stricken by age: γ. ἐὼν πολεμιστής Il. 10.549. Cf. Od. 18.53, 81. Of a thing, old, worn by use: σάκος Od. 22.184. 4 A member of the βουλή, an elder or councillor: βουλὴν γερόντων Il. 2.53. Cf. Il. 2.21, 404, Il. 4.323, 344, Il. 6.113, Il. 9.70, 89, 422, 574, Il. 15.721, Il. 18.448, Il. 19.303, 338 (here including Agamemnon, the king): γέροντας πλέονας καλέσαντες Od. 7.189. Cf. Od. 2.14, Od. 21.21, Od. 24.255. 5 An elder acting as one of a body of judges Il. 18.503.

gerai/rw.head: γεραίρω
gerai/rw.html: γεραίρω [γέρας.] To honour, show honour to: νώτοισι διηνεκέεσσιν Il. 7.321: Od. 14.437, ἀγαθοῖσιν 441.

glh=nos.head: γλῆνος
glh=nos.html: γλῆνος τό [cf. γλήνη.] In pl. γλήνεα, trinketsIl. 24.192.

gai=a.head: γαῖα
gai=a.html:
γαῖα -ης, ἡ [cf. γῆ, αἶα.] 1 The earth: στεναχιζετο γ. Il. 2.95. Cf. Il. 2.699, 782, Il. 6.19, 282, Il. 17.447, etc.: πείρατα γαίης Od. 4.563. Cf. Od. 2.131, Od. 3.16, Od. 4.417, Od. 6.167, Od. 11.239, etc. Personified Il. 3.278: Od. 11.576. 2 The earth as distinguished a From the heavens: μεσσηγὺς γαίης τε καὶ οὐρανοῦ Il. 5.769 = Il. 8.46. Cf. Il. 8.16, Il. 14.174, Il. 15.193: Od. 1.54, Od. 11.18, Od. 12.381. Personified Il. 15.36: Od. 5.184. b From the sea or water: γαίης καὶ πόντοιο Il. 8.479. Cf. Il. 8.24, Il. 14.204: ἐφʼ ὑγρὴν ἠδʼ ἐπὶ γαῖαν Od. 1.98. Cf. Od. 5.294, 359, Od. 11.587, Od. 12.282, Od. 23.238, etc. c From both Il. 18.483: Od. 12.404 = Od. 14.302. 3 The earth considered with reference to extent: πολλὴ γαῖα, many regions or countriesIl. 15.81: Od. 2.364, Od. 4.268, Od. 14.380. So πολλὴν ἐπʼ ἀπείρονα γαῖαν (far and wide on the . . . ) Od. 15.79. Cf. Od. 19.284. 4 a A particular land or country: Ἀχαιΐδα γαῖαν Il. 1.254 = Il. 7.124. Cf. Il. 1.270, Il. 3.49, Il. 5.545, Il. 23.206: γαίῃ ἐν ἀλλοδαπῇ Od. 9.36. Cf. Od. 1.407, Od. 5.35, Od. 6.119, 177, Od. 8.301, etc. b One's native land: πάρος ἣν γαῖαν ἱκέσθαι Od. 1.21, ἐν σῇ ἐὼν γαίῃ Od. 13.294. Cf. Od. 1.59, Od. 4.523, Od. 8.555, Od. 20.99, etc. So πατρὶς γ.: ἐς πατρίδα γαῖαν Il. 2.140. Cf. Il. 3.244, Il. 13.645, 696, Il. 15.505, etc.: Od. 1.290, Od. 3.117, Od. 4.823, Od. 8.461, Od. 10.49, etc. Also γαίῃ πατρωΐῃ Od. 13.188, 251. 5 The surface of the earth, the earth, the ground: ποτὶ σκῆπτρον βάλε γαίῃ Il. 1.245. Cf. Il. 3.114, Il. 4.112, Il. 11.161, Il. 13.200, Il. 20.420, Il. 23.420, etc.: κατακλίνας ἐπὶ γαίῃ Od. 10.165. Cf. Od. 2.80, Od. 8.190, Od. 9.289, Od. 11.423, Od. 18.92, etc. 6 Earth as a material, earth, soil: χυτή με κατὰ γαῖα καλύπτοι Il. 6.464. Cf. Il. 7.99, Il. 14.114, Il. 23.256: ἀμφὶ γαῖαν ἔναξεν Od. 21.122. Cf. Od. 3.258. Of a corpse: κωφὴν γαῖαν (the senseless clay) Il. 24.54.
Γαῖα ΓαιήϊοςΓῆ. See Lexicon.

ganumh/dhs.head: Γανυμήδης
ganumh/dhs.html: Γανυμήδης (αντίθεος). Son of Trus-1. Carried off by the gods to be their cup-bearer Il. 5.266, Il. 20.232.

gasth/r.head: γαστήρ
gasth/r.html: γαστήρ -έρος, ἡ. Genit. γαστρός Od. 15.344. Dat. γαστρί Il. 5.539, 616, Il. 17.519. 1 The belly Il. 4.531, Il. 5.539 = Il. 17.519, Il. 5.616, Il. 13.372 = 398, Il. 13.506, Il. 16.163 (of wolves), 465, Il. 17.313, Il. 19.225, Il. 21.180: Od. 4.369 = Od. 12.332, Od. 9.433 (of a ram). In half-personified sense: κέλεταί ἑ γ. Od. 6.133. Cf. Od. 7.216, Od. 15.344, Od. 17.228, 286, 473, 559, Od. 18.2, 53, 364, 380. 2 The intestine of an animal stuffed with fat and blood and forming some kind of pudding or large sausage Od. 18.44, 118, Od. 20.25. 3 The womb Il. 6.58.

glafu/rai.head: Γλαφύραι
glafu/rai.html: Γλαφύραι A town of the realm of Eumelus, probably lying by the Boebean Lake Il. 2.712.

ga/numai.head: γάνυμαι
ga/numai.html: γάνυμαι [cf. γανάω.] 3 sing. fut. γανύσσεται Il. 14.504. To rejoice, be glad Il. 13.493. To rejoice or take delight in. With dat. Il. 20.405. In reference to persons: ἀνδρὶ φίλῳ ἐλθοντι Il. 14.504. Cf. Od. 12.43.

gai/w.head: γαίω
gai/w.html: γαίω [γαϝ-. Cf. ἀγαυός and L. gaudeo.] Only in phrase κύδεϊ γαίων, of a divinity, glorying in his splendour; or perh., brilliant or glorious with splendour Il. 1.405, Il. 5.906, Il. 8.51 Il. 11.81.

glufi/s.head: γλυφίς
glufi/s.html: γλυφίς -ίδος, ἡ [γλύφω, to cut out, carve. Cf. γλαφυρός.] App., the notch in an arrow to receive the string. In pl. (poss. referring to a double notch (i.e. two notches at right angles)) Il. 4.122: Od. 21.419.

gugai/h.head: Γυγαίη
gugai/h.html: Γυγαίη λίμνη. A lake to the north of Sardis. To Talaemenes bore Mesthles and Antiphus-2 Il. 2.865 , Il. 20.391.

game/w.head: γαμέω
game/w.html: γαμέω [γάμος.] Fut. γαμέω Il. 9.388, 391. Infin. γαμέειν Od. 15.522. 3 sing. aor. ἔγημε Il. 14.121: Od. 11.179, Od. 15.241, Od. 16.34, Od. 23.149. γῆμε Il. 13.433: Od. 1.36, Od. 11.274, 282. Pple γήμας, -αντος Il. 9.399, Il. 11.227. Infin. γῆμαι Od. 21.72, 158. Mid. 3 sing. fut. γαμέσσεται Il. 9.394. 3 sing. aor. opt. γήμαιτο Od. 16.392, Od. 21.162. Fem. pple. γημαμένη Od. 11.273. Infin. γήμασθαι Od. 2.128, Od. 15.17, Od. 18.270, 289, Od. 19.159, 531, Od. 20.335, 342. 1 In act., of a man, to marry, wed: κούρην Il. 9.388, μιν 391, Ἀδρήστοιο θυγατρῶν(partitive genit., one of his daughters) Il. 14.121. Cf. Il. 9.399, Il. 11.227, Il. 13.433: ἄλοχον μνηστήν Od. 1.36 (here of another's wife), Od. 11.179, 274, 282, Od. 15.241, 522, Od. 16.34, Od. 21.72, 158, Od. 23.149. Absol. Od. 4.208. 2 In mid. a Of a woman, to give herself in marriage to, to wed. With dat.: Εὐρυμάχῳ Od. 15.17. Cf. Od. 2.113, 128, Od. 11.273, Od. 16.392 = Od. 21.162, Od. 18.270, 289, Od. 20.335, 342. Absol. Od. 1.275, Od. 19.159, 531. b App., to get (a wife for one's son): Πηλεύς μοι γυναῖκα γαμέσσεται Il. 9.394 (v.l. γε μάσσεται).

gu/y.head: γύψ
gu/y.html: γύψ γυπός, ὁ. A vulture (except in Od. 11.578 always preying on carrion. Cf. αἰγυπιός) Il. 4.237, Il. 11.162, Il. 16.836, Il. 18.271, Il. 22.42: Od. 11.578, Od. 22.30.

gamfhlai/.head: γαμφηλαί
gamfhlai/.html: γαμφηλαί αἱ. The jaws of an animal. Of lions Il. 13.200, Il. 16.489. Of horses Il. 19.394.

ga/la.head: γάλα
ga/la.html: γάλα γάλακτος, τό [cf. γλάγος.] Milk Il. 4.434, Il. 5.902: Od. 4.88, 89, Od. 9.246, 297, Od. 10.304.

gouno/s.head: γουνός
gouno/s.html: γουνός [perh. fr. γονϝ-, γόνυ, in sense swell, knoll, and, in reference to a vineyard, etc., the part best catching the sun, and therefore the most fruitful.] γουνῷ (γουνὸν) ἀλωῆς Il. 9.534, Il. 18.57 = 438: Od. 1.193, Od. 11.193, ἐς γουνὸν Ἀθηνάων Od. 11.323 (here perh. the reference is to the citadel).

go/nu.head: γόνυ
go/nu.html: γόνυ τό. Genit. γουνός (for γονϝ-ός) Il. 11.547: Od. 19.450. γούνατος Il. 21.591. Nom. pl. γούνατα Il. 4.314, Il. 9.610, Il. 19.166, Il. 21.114, etc.: Od. 4.703, Od. 5.297, Od. 13.34, Od. 23.3, etc. γοῦνα Il. 6.511, Il. 14.468, Il. 21.611, etc.: Od. 20.352. Genit. γούνων Il. 1.407, Il. 6.45, Il. 21.65, Il. 22.338, etc.: Od. 6.142, Od. 10.264, Od. 22.310, 339, etc. Dat. γούνασι Il. 5.370, Il. 6.92, Il. 17.514, Il. 22.500, etc.: Od. 1.267, Od. 7.142, Od. 16.443, Od. 21.55, etc. γούνεσσι Il. 9.488, Il. 17.451, 569. Acc. γούνατα Il. 5.176, Il. 11.609, Il. 21.52, Il. 24.478, etc.: Od. 3.92, Od. 5.453, Od. 14.236, Od. 24.381, etc. γοῦνα Il. 14.437, Il. 20.93, Il. 22.204: Od. 6.147, Od. 9.266, Od. 18.395. 1 The knee of men or animals: ῥίμφα ἑ γοῦνα φέρει Il. 6.511 = Il. 15.268. Cf. Il. 7.118, Il. 10.358, Il. 11.547, Il. 14.437, 468, Il. 15.269, Il. 17.386, Il. 19.72, Il. 20.458, Il. 21.302, 591, 611, Il. 22.24, 144, 452, Il. 23.731: ἔλασε γουνὸς ὕπερ Od. 19.450. Cf. Od. 5.453, Od. 20.352, Od. 23.3. 2 In pl., the knees regarded as the seat of strength, as symbolizing the strength (cf. γυῖα 3): βλάψε οἱ γούνατα Il. 7.271. Cf. Il. 4.314, Il. 5.176 = Il. 16.425, Il. 9.610 = Il. 10.90, Il. 11.477, 578 = Il. 13.412 = Il. 17.349, Il. 13.360, 711, Il. 15.291, Il. 17.451, 569, Il. 19.166, 354, Il. 20.93, Il. 21.52, 114, 270, 425, Il. 22.204, 335, 388, Il. 23.444, Il. 24.498: τῆς λύτο γούνατα Od. 4.703 = Od. 23.205. Cf. Od. 5.297 = 406 = Od. 22.147, Od. 13.34, Od. 14.69, 236, Od. 18.133, 212, Od. 20.118, Od. 22.68, Od. 24.345, 381. 3 Of clasping the knees in supplication: λαβέ [μιν] γούνων (by the knees) Il. 1.407. Cf. Il. 1.500, 512, 557, Il. 6.45, Il. 15.76, Il. 20.468, Il. 21.65, 68, 71, Il. 22.345, Il. 24.357, 465, 478: μητρὸς ποτὶ γούνασι χεῖρας βάλλειν Od. 6.310. Cf. Od. 6.142, 147, 169, Od. 7.142, Od. 10.264, 323, Od. 22.310, 339, 342, 365. So with a word of seizing to be supplied: λισσέσκετο γούνων Il. 9.451. Cf. Od. 10.481, Od. 22.337. Sim.: περὶ γούνατʼ ἐμὰ στήσεσθαι λισσομένους Il. 11.609. Cf. Il. 18.457, Il. 20.463: σὰ γούναθʼ ἱκάνω Od. 5.449, Od. 7.147, Ἀμφινόμου πρὸς γοῦνα καθέζετο (as putting himself under his protection) Od. 18.395. Cf. Od. 3.92 = Od. 4.322, Od. 9.266, Od. 13.231. Also λίσσομʼ ὑπὲρ γούνων Il. 22.338. Of kissing the knees in supplication: ἥ οἱ γούνατʼ ἔκυσσε Il. 8.371. Cf. Od. 14.279. 4 By extension, in pl., the knee(s) and thigh(s) of a sitting person: ἐν γούνασι πῖπτε διώνης (on her knee) Il. 5.370, Ἀθηναίης ἐπὶ γούνασιν (on the lap, i.e., app., of a seated statue) Il. 6.92, 273, 303. Cf. Il. 5.408, Il. 9.455, 488, Il. 21.506, Il. 22.500: ἐμὲ γούνασιν οἷσιν ἐφεσσάμενος Od. 16.443. Cf. Od. 19.401, Od. 21.55.–ταῦτα θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται, the issue lies with the gods(perh. referring to the custom of placing gifts on the lap of a statue (cf. Il. 6.92, 273, 303 cited above), the gifts being irrevocably dedicated, and symbolizing complete submission to divine governance) Il. 17.514 = Il. 20.435: = Od. 1.267 = Od. 16.129, Od. 1.400.

geraio/s.head: γεραιός
geraio/s.html: γεραιός -ή [γέρων.] 1 Absol. in masc., an old man (always of a dignified person): ἠρᾶθʼ ὁ γ. Il. 1.35. Cf. Il. 3.191, 225, Il. 10.77, Il. 11.632, 645, Il. 14.39, Il. 24.162, 252, 279, 302, 322: Od. 3.373. In voc. as a term of respectful address Il. 10.164, 167, 558, Il. 11.648, 653, Il. 24.390, 433, 618. Joined with ἄττα Il. 9.607, Il. 17.561. Without the notion of respect Od. 2.201, Od. 14.131, 185. 2 Absol. in fem., an old woman (app. referring to those of the higher classes): ξυνάγουσα γεραιάς Il. 6.87. Cf. Il. 6.270, 287, 296. 3 In comp. γεραίτερος a Older: ὃς σεῖο γ. εὔχομαι εἶναι Il. 9.60. Absol. Od. 3.24. b Old rather than young, elderly: κῆρυξ Il. 24.149, 178. Cf. Od. 3.362.

glaktofa/gos.head: γλακτοφάγος
glaktofa/gos.html: γλακτοφάγος [γαλακτοφάγος, fr. γαλακτ-, γάλα + φάγον.] Living on (mare's) milk Il. 13.6.

ga/strh.head: γάστρη
ga/strh.html: γάστρη -ης, ἡ [ = γαστήρ.] The lower and rounded part of a vessel: τρίποδος Il. 18.348: = Od. 8.437.

ga/rgaron.head: Γάργαρον
ga/rgaron.html: Γάργαρον A peak of Mt. Ida Il. 8.48, Il. 14.292, 352, Il. 15.152.

ghqosu/nh.head: γηθοσύνη
ghqosu/nh.html: γηθοσύνη -ης, ἡ [γηθέω.] Joy, delight: ἐγέλασσέ οἱ ἦτορ γηθοσύνῃ Il. 21.390. Of the sea Il. 13.29.

ge/nto.head: γέντο
ge/nto.html: γέντο 3 sing. aor. To seize or grasp: ἱμάσθλην Il. 8.43 = Il. 13.25. Cf. Il. 13.241, Il. 18.476, 477.

ga/r.head: γάρ
ga/r.html: γάρ [γ(ε) ἄρ.] 1 Introducing the ground or reason for something said. a The γάρ clause following, for, since, seeing that Il. 1.55, 56, 63, 78, 81, 86, etc.: Od. 1.7, 29, 40, 78, 114, 152, etc. b The γάρ clause coming first, since, seeing that Il. 2.803, Il. 12.326, Il. 13.736, Il. 15.739, Il. 23.156, etc.: Od. 1.301, 337, Od. 5.29, Od. 10.174, Od. 12.154, etc. 2 Introducing an explanation, reason, amplification, or analysis of something previously said (often with καί; see καί 3) Il. 1.9, 12, 80, 262, 295, 355, Il. 2.119, Il. 4.226, 301, Il. 8.148, Il. 10.352, Il. 12.322, etc.: Od. 1.33, 260, Od. 2.89, Od. 3.89, 362, Od. 4.86, Od. 6.164, Od. 9.319, 432 (the clause here introduced parenthetically), Od. 11.69, Od. 20.42, Od. 21.232, etc. 3 Introducing as a kind of interjection a question or expression with something of an abrupt effect (sometimes translatable, why . . ., well . . .): πῶς γάρ τοι δώσουσι γέρας ; Il. 1.123, ἦ γάρ κεν δειλὸς καλεοίμην Il. 1.293. Cf. Il. 10.61, Il. 15.201, Il. 18.182, etc.: πῶς γάρ με κέλεαι . . .; Od. 10.337, εἰ γάρ κεν σὺ μίμνοις Od. 15.545. Cf. Od. 8.159, Od. 10.383, Od. 14.115, Od. 15.509, Od. 16.222, etc. For αἲ γάρ, εἰ γάρ in wishes see αἴ 1, εἰ 2.b. 4 Idiomatically following the relative ὅς : ὃ γάρ κʼ ὄχʼ ἄριστον εἴη (for that . . .) Il. 12.344 = 357, ὃ γὰρ γέρας ἐστὶ θανόντων Il. 23.9: ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν Od. 1.286. Cf. Od. 17.172, Od. 24.190. So following ἵνα: ἵνα γάρ σφιν ἐπέφραδον ἠγερέθεσθαι (for there . . .) Il. 10.127. And ὡς: ὡς γὰρ ἀνώγει (for so he bade) Il. 9.690, ὡς γὰρ ἔμοιγε (for so he was to me) Il. 24.68, etc.: ὡς γάρ οἱ μοῖρʼ ἐστὶ . . . (for this is his destiny, to . . .) Od. 5.41. Cf. Od. 8.79, Od. 20.282, etc. (In such cases the demonstrative ὥ (ὧς) is also read.)

gla/gos.head: γλάγος
gla/gos.html: γλάγος τό [cf. γάλα.] Milk Il. 2.471 = Il. 16.643.

gela/w.head: †γελάω
gela/w.html: †γελάω 3 sing. aor. (ἐ)γέλασσε Il. 6.471, Il. 15.101, Il. 19.362, Il. 21.389, 408: Od. 9.413, Od. 17.542, Od. 18.163. 3 pl. γέλασαν Il. 23.840. (ἐ)γέλασσαν Il. 2.270, Il. 23.784: Od. 18.320, Od. 20.358, Od. 21.376. Pple. γελάσας Od. 2.301. γελάσσας Il. 11.378, Il. 21.508. Fem. γελάσασα Il. 6.484. Infin. γελάσαι Od. 14.465. Also pres. γελόω Od. 21.105. Pl. pple. γελόωντες Od. 18.40, Od. 20.374. γελώωντες Od. 18.111, Od. 20.390. (ἐκ-.) 1 To smile: δακρυόεν Il. 6.484, χείλεσιν (i.e. with a forced smile) Il. 15.101. Cf. Od. 17.542, Od. 21.105. Of the earth, to be bright Il. 19.362. Of the heart, to rejoice Il. 21.389: Od. 9.413 (here app. connoting inward derisive laughter. See 2.b). 2 a To laugh Il. 6.471, Il. 11.378, Il. 21.408, 508: Od. 2.301, Od. 14.465, Od. 18.40, 111, 163, 320, Od. 20.390. b To laugh (at a person): ἐπʼ αὐτῷ Il. 2.270, Il. 23.784: = Od. 20.358 = Od. 21.376, ἐπὶ ξείνοις Od. 20.374. With ἐπί advbl. Il. 23.840.

gambro/s.head: γαμβρός
gambro/s.html: γαμβρός -οῦ, ὁ. 1 A son-in-law Il. 6.177, 178, 249, Il. 9.142, 284, Il. 11.739, Il. 13.428, Il. 24.331: Od. 3.387, Od. 4.569, Od. 7.313, Od. 8.582 (but this might come under (2)), Od. 19.406. 2 A brother-in-law Il. 5.474, Il. 13.464, 466.

glisa=s.head: Γλισᾶς
glisa=s.html: Γλισᾶς A Boeotian town Il. 2.504.

ga/mos.head: γάμος
ga/mos.html: γάμος -ου, ὁ. 1 A contracting of marriage, one's marriage: ὄφρα συνώμεθα ἀμφὶ γάμῳ Il. 13.382: γάμον τεύξουσιν Od. 1.277 = Od. 2.196. Cf. Od. 1.249 = Od. 16.126, Od. 2.97 = Od. 19.142 = Od. 24.132, Od. 2.205, Od. 4.7,Od. 6.27, 66, 288, Od. 15.126, 524, Od. 17.476, Od. 18.272, Od. 19.137, 157, Od. 20.341, Od. 21.250, Od. 22.50, Od. 24.126. 2 A marriage, a wedding, a wedding-feast: γάμοι εἰλαπίναι τε Il. 18.491. Cf. Il. 19.299, Il. 24.62: δαινύντα γάμον Od. 4.3. Cf. Od. 1.226, Od. 4.770, Od. 11.415, Od. 20.307, Od. 23.135. 3 Marriage, wedlock: ἱμερόεντα ἔργα γάμοιο Il. 5.429: ἐκλελάθοιτό κε γάμοιο Od. 3.224. Cf. Od. 20.74.

go/os.head: γόος
go/os.html: γόος -ου, ὁ. 1 Weeping, wailing, lamentation, mourning Il. 5.156, Il. 6.499, Il. 17.37, Il. 18.51, Il. 23.10, 14, etc.: Od. 4.102, 113, Od. 8.540, Od. 16.144, Od. 19.268, Od. 21.228, etc. In pl.: ὀδύνας τε γόους τε Od. 1.242. 2 Inclination to weep: πᾶσιν ὑπέδυ γ. Od. 10.398. 3 Mourning rites, formal mourning or lamentation: ἦρχε γόοιο Il. 24.723. Cf. Il. 24.747, 761.

gu/alon.head: γύαλον
gu/alon.html: γύαλον -ου, τό [cf. γυρός.] (ἐγγυαλίζω). One of the two curved plates, front and back, of which the θώρηξ was formed. The front plate Il. 5.99, 189, Il. 13.507 = Il. 17.314, Il. 13.587. In pl. of the two plates Il. 15.530.

gnh/sios.head: γνήσιος
gnh/sios.html: γνήσιος [γ(ε)ν-, γίγνομαι.] (Lawfully) begotten, born in wedlock, legitimate Il. 11.102: Od. 14.202.

ge/nos.head: γένος
ge/nos.html: γένος τό [γεν-, γίγνομαι.] 1 Race, stock, family = γενεή 1, γενέθλη 1: γ. ἦν ἐκ ποταμοῖο (was by race sprung from . . .) Il. 5.544. Cf. Il. 5.896, Il. 6.209, Il. 14.113, 126, Il. 21.186, Il. 23.347: Od. 4.63, Od. 14.199, 204, Od. 15.267, 533, Od. 16.62, 401, Od. 17.373, Od. 19.116, 162, Od. 21.335, Od. 24.269, 508, 512. One's descent: γ. μοι ἔνθεν ὅθεν σοί Il. 4.58. Cf. Il. 13.354. 2 Source, origin = γενέθλη 3: ὅθεν ἡμιόνων γ. Il. 2.852 (whence come . . .). 3 A race or generation = γενεή 2: ἡμιθέων ἀνδρῶν Il. 12.23. Cf. Od. 4.62, Od. 17.523, Od. 20.212. 4 App., a generation considered as a period: τρὶς ἀνάξασθαι γένεʼ ἀνδρῶν (during three generations) Od. 3.245. 5 The members of one's family: μεθʼ αἶμά τε καὶ γ. αὐτῶν Od. 8.583. 6 Offspring, a child: δῖον γ. Il. 9.538, σὸν γένος Il. 19.124. So of the Chimaera: θεῖον γ. (as being of divine origin) Il. 6.180. 7 In reference to the date of one's birth, age, one's years = γενεή 5: γένει ὕστερος ἦεν (was the younger) Il. 3.215. 8 One's birthplace = γενεή 6 Od. 6.35.

gouneu/s.head: Γουνεύς
gouneu/s.html: Γουνεύς Greek. Leader of the Enienes and Peraebians Il. 2.748 .

gouna/zomai.head: γουνάζομαι
gouna/zomai.html: γουνάζομαι [γουν-, γόνυ. To clasp the knees, clasp by the knees, in supplication. Cf. γόνυ 3.] Fut. γουνάσομαι Il. 1.427. To supplicate, entreat. Retaining the genitival construction of a vb. of taking hold, and with the construction extended to something appealed to: μή με γούνων γουνάζεο μηδὲ τοκήων Il. 22.345. With this latter construction alone: τῶν ὄπιθέν σε γουνάζομαι Od. 11.66. With prepositional clauses indicating what is appealed to: τῶν ὕπερ Il. 15.665. Cf. Od. 11.66, Od. 13.324. With simple acc. of the person entreated: γουνάσομαί μιν Il. 1.427. Absol. Il. 11.130.

ge/ranos.head: γέρανος
ge/ranos.html: γέρανος -ου, ἡ. A crane Il. 2.460 = Il. 15.692, Il. 3.3.

ge/gwna.head: γέγωνα
ge/gwna.html: γέγωνα pf. (with pres. sense). Infin. γεγωνέμεν Il. 8.223, Il. 11.6. 3 sing. plupf. (in impf. sense) ἐγεγώνει Il. 22.34, Il. 23.425: Od. 21.368. From pres. γεγώνω 3 sing. impf. (ἐ)γέγωνε Il. 14.469, Il. 24.703: Od. 8.305. From pres. γεγωνέω impf. (ἐ)γεγώνευν Od. 12.370, Od. 17.161. 3 pl. γεγώνευν Od. 9.47. Infin. γεγωνεῖν Il. 12.337. 1 To make one's voice heard: οὔ πώς οἱ ἔην βώσαντι γεγωνεῖν Il. 12.337. Cf. Il. 8.223 = Il. 11.6: Od. 5.400 = Od. 9.473 = Od. 12.181, Od. 6.294.–αὔειν γεγωνώς, to shout making oneself heard, i.e. in a sustained and loud voiceIl. 8.227 = Il. 11.275 = 586 = Il. 17.247, Il. 12.439 = Il. 13.149. 2 To shout (with implication that one makes oneself heard): ἐγέγωνε Πουλυδάμαντι Il. 14.469. Cf. Il. 22.34, Il. 23.425, Il. 24.703: Od. 8.305, Od. 9.47, Od. 12.370, Od. 21.368. 3 To declare something aloud Od. 17.161.

glh/nh.head: γλήνη
glh/nh.html: γλήνη -ης, ἡ [app. something bright. Cf. γλῆνος.] 1 The eye, the eyeball Il. 14.494: Od. 9.390. 2 A plaything, a doll or puppet: ἔρρε, κακὴ γλήνη Il. 8.164.

guio/w.head: γυιόω
guio/w.html: γυιόω [γυιός, lame.] (ἀπο-.) To lame, cripple: γυιώσω σθωῒν ἵππους Il. 8.402. Cf. Il. 8.416.

geneth/.head: γενετή
geneth/.html: γενετή -ῆς, ἡ [γεν-, γίγνομαι.] One's birth: ἐκ γενετῆς Il. 24.535 (from his birth (onwards)): Od. 18.6 (to be his from his birth, i.e. on his birth).

go/rtus.head: Γόρτυς
go/rtus.html: Γόρτυς (τειχιόεσσα). A city of Crete Il. 2.646 : part of the fleet of Menelaus wrecked near it Od. 3.294.

ga/lows.head: γάλοως
ga/lows.html: γάλοως ἡ. Dat. γαλόῳ Il. 3.122. Nom. pl. γαλόῳ Il. 22.473. A sister-in-law, a sister of one's husband Il. 3.122, Il. 6.378, 383, Il. 22.473, Il. 24.769.

gna/mptw.head: †γνάμπτω
gna/mptw.html: †γνάμπτω [ = κνάμπτω.] 3 sing. aor. γνάμψε. (ἀνα-, ἐπι-, περι-) To bend: ἐν γόνυ γνάμψεν (app., crooked his knee round the other's leg) Il. 23.731.

gala/teia.head: Γαλάτεια
gala/teia.html: Γαλάτεια (ἀγακλειτή). A Nereid Il. 18.45 .

gluku/qumos.head: γλυκύθυμος
gluku/qumos.html: γλυκύθυμος [γλυκύς + θυμός.] Of gentle or kindly mind: ἀνήρ Il. 20.467.

gene/qlh.head: γενέθλη
gene/qlh.html: γενέθλη -ης, ἡ [as γενεή.] 1 Race, stock = γενεή 1, γένος 1: σῆς ἐκ γενέθλης Il. 19.111: παιήονός εἰσι γενέθλης (of the race of . . .) Od. 4.232. Cf. Od. 13.130. 2 Of mares, a brood: τῶν ἓξ ἐγένοντο γ. Il. 5.270 (γ. being predicate). 3 Source, origin = γένος 2: ὅθεν ἀργύρου ἐστὶ γ. (whence comes . . .) Il. 2.857.

glouto/s.head: γλουτός
glouto/s.html: γλουτός -οῦ, ὁ. One of the buttocks: δεξιόν Il. 5.66, Il. 13.651. In pl., the buttocks, the rump Il. 8.340.

ghqo/sunos.head: γηθόσυνος
ghqo/sunos.html: γηθόσυνος -η [as γηθοσύνη.] Joyful, glad, rejoicing Il. 4.272 = 326, Il. 7.122, Il. 13.82, Il. 18.557: Od. 5.269, Od. 11.540.

ge/nus.head: γένυς
ge/nus.html: γένυς ἡ. Dat. pl. γένυσσι Il. 11.416. Acc. pl. γένυς Od. 11.320. In pl., the jaws Il. 11.416, Il. 23.688: Od. 11.320.

gonh/.head: γονή
gonh/.html: γονή -ῆς, ἡ [γον-, γεν-, γίγνομαι.] 1 Offspring Il. 24.539. 2 Progeny, descendants: Ἀρκεισιάδαο Od. 4.755.

gnampto/s.head: γναμπτός
gnampto/s.html: γναμπτός -ή, -όν [γνάμπτω.] 1 Bent, curved: ἕλικας Il. 18.401: ἀγκίστροισιν Od. 4.369 = Od. 12.332. 2 Fig., that can be bent or influenced: νόημα Il. 24.41. 3 As epithet of the limbs, flexible, lissom Il. 11.669, Il. 24.359: Od. 11.394, Od. 13.398, 430, Od. 21.283. Sim. of jaws, moving freely in their sockets Il. 11.416.

gana/w.head: †γανάω
gana/w.html: †γανάω [cf. γάνυμαι.] Nom. pl. masc. pres. pple. γανόωντες Il. 13.265. Fem. γανόωσαι Il. 19.359: Od. 7.128. Of polished metal, to shine, gleam Il. 13.265, Il. 19.359. Of vegetation, to be brightly green: πρασιαί Od. 7.128.

gunh/.head: γυνή
gunh/.html: γυνή γυναικός, ἡ. Voc. γύναι (see 5 below). 1 A woman in gen. Il. 1.348, Il. 2.226, Il. 3.72, Il. 4.141, Il. 5.349, Il. 9.128, Il. 11.269, Il. 12.433, etc.: Od. 1.332, Od. 3.154, Od. 7.57, Od. 11.258, Od. 13.288, Od. 15.20, Od. 18.248, Od. 19.235, etc. 2 The mistress of a house Od. 16.334, Od. 21.86. 3 In pl., the female servants in a house: τετυγμένα χερσὶ γυναικῶν Il. 22.511. Cf. Il. 18.559: εἰς ὅ κʼ εἴπω γυναιξὶ δεῖπνον τετυκεῖν Od. 15.76. Cf. Od. 2.108, Od. 16.304, Od. 17.75, Od. 18.186, Od. 19.16, Od. 22.437, etc. With ἀμφίπολος Od. 1.362, Od. 6.52, Od. 7.235, Od. 16.413, Od. 21.8, etc. With δμῳή Il. 6.323, Il. 9.477: Od. 7.103, Od. 13.66, Od. 16.108 = Od. 20.318, Od. 17.505, Od. 19.490, Od. 22.37, etc. In sing., one of the servants Od. 15.417, 434, 439, Od. 19.344, etc. With words indicating the servant's country of origin: Φοίνισσα Od. 15.417, Σικελή Od. 24.211. Her office: ταμίη Il. 6.390: Od. 2.345, Od. 3.479, ἀλετρίς Od. 20.105. 4 Specifically. a A woman as distinguished from a man: γυναικὸς ἀντὶ τέτυξο Il. 8.163. Cf. Il. 7.139, 236, Il. 9.134, Il. 15.683, etc.: οὔτʼ ἄνδρʼ οὔτε γυναῖκα Od. 4.142, Od. 6.161. Cf. Od. 7.109, Od. 13.308, Od. 15.163, Od. 19.408, etc. b A wife: σὺν γυναιξί τε καὶ τεκέεσσιν Il. 4.162. Cf. Il. 3.48, Il. 6.160, Il. 8.57, Il. 9.394, Il. 17.36, etc.: ἀνὴρ ἠδὲ γ. Od. 6.184. Cf. Od. 1.13, 433, Od. 2.249, Od. 7.347, Od. 14.211, Od. 17.152, Od. 21.72, etc. c A concubine as opposed to a wife Il. 24.497. d A woman as distinguished from a goddess: θεᾶς οὐδὲ γυναικός Il. 14.315. Cf. Il. 16.176, Il. 24.58: ἢ θεὸς ἠὲ γ. Od. 10.228, 255. With words indicative of mortality: θνητάων Il. 20.305: θνητήν Od. 11.244. 5 In voc. as a term of courteous or respectful address, lady Il. 3.204, 438, Il. 6.441, Il. 24.300: Od. 4.148, Od. 6.168, Od. 8.424, Od. 11.248, etc.

gnu/c.head: γνύξ
gnu/c.html: γνύξ [γόνυ.] On the knee or the knees: ἔριπεν Il. 5.68. Cf. Il. 5.309, 357, Il. 8.329, Il. 11.355, Il. 20.417.

go/nos.head: γόνος
go/nos.html: γόνος -ου, ὁ [as γονή.] 1 One sprung or born. a The offspring, a child: διός Il. 5.635. Cf. Il. 24.59: Od. 2.274, Od. 4.207, Od. 18.218. b A remoter descendant Il. 6.191, Il. 13.449. c In both these senses: ὃν (i.e. Λαέρταο) καὶ Ὀδυσσῆος Od. 4.741. 2 The race: ἀτρέος Od. 11.436. 3 Offspring Il. 9.493: Od. 4.12, Od. 12.130. One's children or family: νεώτατος γόνοιο Il. 20.409. 4 One's parentage: ὃν γόνον ἐξαγόρευεν Od. 11.234. Cf. Od. 1.216, Od. 19.166.

gh=ras.head: γῆρας
gh=ras.html: γῆρας -αος, τό [cf. γέρων.] Dat. γήραϊ Il. 3.150, Il. 5.153, Il. 23.644, etc.: Od. 2.16, Od. 15.357, Od. 24.233. γήρᾳ Od. 11.136, Od. 23.283. Old age Il. 1.29, Il. 3.150, Il. 4.315, 321, Il. 5.153, Il. 8.103, Il. 9.446, Il. 10.79, Il. 18.434, 515, Il. 19.336, Il. 22.60, 420 (my years), Il. 23.623, 644, Il. 24.487: Od. 1.218, Od. 2.16, Od. 11.136 = Od. 23.283, Od. 11.196, 497, Od. 13.59, Od. 15.246, 348, 357, Od. 23.24, 212, Od. 24.233, 249, 390. The period of old age: ἐς γῆρας Il. 14.86. Cf. Od. 8.226, Od. 19.368, Od. 23.286.

glaukw=pis.head: γλαυκῶπις
glaukw=pis.html: γλαυκῶπις -ιδος [γλαυκός + ὦπα.] Acc. γλαυκώπιδα Il. 8.373. γλαυκῶπιν Od. 1.156. (The) bright-eyed (maid) (prob. without any notion of colour). Epithet or a name of Athene Il. 1.206, Il. 2.166, Il. 5.29, Il. 6.88, Il. 8.373, etc.: Od. 1.44, 156, Od. 2.433, Od. 3.13, 135, etc.

grai=a.head: Γραῖα
grai=a.html: Γραῖα A Boeotian town Il. 2.498.

gerh/nios.head: Γερήνιος
gerh/nios.html: Γερήνιος Adj. from (apparently) the name of an unknown place, said to have been in Elis and to have sheltered Nestor when an exile from Pylus. Of Nestor Il. 2.336 , Il. 4.317, Il. 7.170, Il. 11.516, Il. 14.52, Il. 15.370, etc. : Od. 3.68, 102, 210, Od. 4.161, etc.

geraro/s.head: γεραρός
geraro/s.html: γεραρός [γέρας.] Of dignified bearing, majestic Il. 3.170. In comp. γεραρώτερος Il. 3.211.

gwruto/s.head: γωρυτός
gwruto/s.html: γωρυτός -οῦ, ὁ. A case for a bow Od. 21.54.

gei/twn.head: γείτων
gei/twn.html: γείτων -ονος. A neighbour Od. 4.16, Od. 5.489, Od. 9.48.

go/mfos.head: γόμφος
go/mfos.html: γόμφος -ου, ὁ. A wooden peg, a treenail Od. 5.248.

geneia/w.head: γενειάω
geneia/w.html: γενειάω [γενειάς.] To get a beard, i.e. attain manhood: παῖδα γενειήσαντα Od. 18.176. Cf. Od. 18.269.

gnw/rimos.head: γνώριμος
gnw/rimos.html: γνώριμος [γνω-, γιγνώσκω.] (Well-) known. Absol., a friend or acquaintance Od. 16.9.

grai/h.head: γραίη
grai/h.html: γραίη -ης, ἡ. = γρηΰς: πυκιμηδέος Od. 1.438.

geneia/s.head: γενειάς
geneia/s.html: γενειάς -άδος, ἡ [γένειον.] In pl., the hair on the chin, the beard: γενειάδες ἀμφὶ γένειον Od. 16.176.

gu/naios.head: γύναιος
gu/naios.html: γύναιος [γυνή.] Of a woman: δώρων (given to a woman) Od. 11.521, Od. 15.247.

gaih/ios.head: γαιήϊος
gaih/ios.html: γαιήϊος [γαῖα.] Of the Earth: υἱόν Od. 7.324.

gunaikei=os.head: γυναικεῖος
gunaikei=os.html: γυναικεῖος -η, -ον [γυναικ-, γυνή.] Of a woman: βουλάς Od. 11.437.

galh/nh.head: γαλήνη
galh/nh.html: γαλήνη -ης, ἡ. A calm. 1 Of the winds Od. 5.391, Od. 12.168. 2 Of the sea: ἐλόωσι γαλήνην (through a calm sea) Od. 7.319. Cf. Od. 5.452, Od. 10.94.

gurai/.head: Γυραί
gurai/.html: Γυραί A rock of unknown site on which Aias-2 was destroyed by Poseidon Od. 4.500.

galaqhno/s.head: γαλαθηνός
galaqhno/s.html: γαλαθηνός [γάλα + θη-, θάομαι2.] Still sucking the mother's milk: νεβρούς Od. 4.336 = Od. 17.127.

gelasto/s.head: γελαστός
gelasto/s.html: γελαστός [γελάω.] Tending to, conceived in a spirit of, mockery; or perh., laughable: ἔργα Od. 8.307.

guro/s.head: γυρός
guro/s.html: γυρός [cf. γυῖα, γύαλον.] Bent, rounded Od. 19.246.

geraisto/s.head: Γεραιστός
geraisto/s.html: Γεραιστός The south west point of Euboea Od. 3.177.

graptu/s.head: γραπτύς
graptu/s.html: γραπτύς ἡ [γραπ-, γράφω.] Acc. pl. γραπτῦς. A scratch: γραπτῦς ἀλεείνων Od. 24.229.

gaulo/s.head: γαυλός
gaulo/s.html: γαυλός -οῦ. Some kind of vessel for milk Od. 9.223.
